_comment: The club's commercial offer, and the only place it is written down.
The API serves it to the offer page, the invoice uses it for line items,
and tools/sync_tiers.py writes it into the landing page, so these numbers
cannot drift between what a visitor is shown and what they are charged.
NUMBERS NEED THE WINERY'S SIGN-OFF. The Founder's Reserve carries the
price already published on the site; The Full Case and Inner Circle are
proposals the winery has confirmed. The entry tier (The Cellar Door, 4
bottles at $180) was withdrawn in October 2026 and is not offered — the
Founder's Reserve is now the way in. Every remaining tier includes
shipping, so an order raises a single line; the shipping line and its
QuickBooks item only come back if a tier charges for carriage again.
Deerfield Ranch, the reference, ships four times a year. This ships twice,
which is what the rest of the site says and what 6,808 bottles a year can
actually support. Changing it is one field.

tiers.name: The Founder's Reserve
tiers.label: Inner Allocation
tiers.summary: For those who want everything the cellar offers, including wines we never release publicly.
benefits: 6 bottles per shipment, including library wines
4 complimentary tastings per visit, three visits a year
Annual harvest dinner with Robert & Cecilia

tiers.name: The Full Case
tiers.label: By the Case
tiers.summary: A full case of every current release, twice a year. For the table that goes through it.
benefits: 12 bottles per shipment, every current release
6 complimentary tastings per visit, three visits a year
Annual harvest dinner with Robert & Cecilia

tiers.name: The Inner Circle
tiers.label: By Invitation
tiers.summary: Everything the cellar makes, including the single barrels that never leave it, and the run of the winery itself.
benefits: 12 bottles per shipment, with single-barrel selections
Unlimited tastings for up to six guests
The fermentation floor and the barrel room, by appointment
